Man Shot Dead in Karnal; Gang Claim Under Police Review

A 28-year-old man was shot dead by assailants on a motorcycle in Karnal. Following the incident, social media claims of involvement by the Himanshu Bhau gang came under police scrutiny. The victim was identified as a Dalit man.
